title: Inspect and extend: Integrating a coherent social-feed release
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/feedContext.tsx` to demonstrate and safely improve end-to-end feature tracing, persistence evidence, and safe demo scope.
problem: Follow a user action from screen through context to model and storage, and back to the rendered list. Use this map to design an integration demo that labels local-only behavior honestly. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/feedContext.tsx` and the related project files: App.tsx; src/feedContext.tsx; src/screens/FeedScreen.tsx; src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx; test/feed.test.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to end-to-end feature tracing, persistence evidence, and safe demo scope.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: The app is a learning implementation, not upstream Bluesky client parity.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Follow a user action from screen through context to model and storage, and back to the rendered list. Use this map to design an integration demo that labels local-only behavior honestly.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/feedContext.tsx`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
